response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as num_line_items FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY num_line_items DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: derived_product_cost is never 0; if it is, NULL division behavior is acceptable

alternatives.interpretation: The average ratio could mean the ratio of aggregated totals (SUM of derived_total_cost divided by SUM of derived_product_cost) rather than the arithmetic mean of per-line-item ratios
alternatives.sql: SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(derived_product_cost) as ratio, COUNT(*) as num_line_items FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY num_line_items DESC LIMIT 10
